rundown: Chiefs beat Cardinals 34-7 at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City, MO in front of 73,511. Chiefs led 27-7 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Chiefs won it 14-0. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 89%).
Scoring: Cardinals 1 touchdown and 0 field goals; Chiefs 4 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: Xavier Worthy 18 Yd pass from Patrick Mahomes (Harrison Butker Kick) (4th quarter, 14:54).

Leading the way — Cardinals: Josh Johnson 18/31, 155 yds, 1 TD; Bam Knight 7 car, 35 yds; Harrison Wallace III 4 rec, 57 yds. Chiefs: Patrick Mahomes 27/39, 324 yds, 3 TD; Emmett Johnson 23 car, 105 yds, 1 TD; Travis Kelce 6 rec, 74 yds, 2 TD.
Where Chiefs won it: they outgained them 435 yards to 205 and held the ball 32:26 to 27:34.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Chiefs closed as 14.5-point favorites and covered by 12.5; the total closed at 40.5 and they combined for 41, over by 0.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 22, 12:58 PM ET. It had Cardinals 14% and Chiefs 86%, projecting Cardinals 15.7 – Chiefs 29.7 (45.4 total, Chiefs by 14).

Final: Cardinals 7 – Chiefs 34. Right winner: it had Chiefs at 86%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Cardinals came in with a 15% below average attack and a 8% leakier than average defense (3-7, 18.4 scored and 28.9 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 50 and 56 games of evidence. Projected to score 15.7, they scored 7 (−8.7 points, 55% under); projected to allow 29.7, they allowed 34 (+4.3 points, 14% over).

Chiefs came in with a 9% above average attack and a 9% stingier than average defense (7-2, 26.3 scored and 17.3 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 53 and 53 games of evidence. Projected to score 29.7, they scored 34 (+4.3 points, 14% over); projected to allow 15.7, they allowed 7 (−8.7 points, 55% under).

The bigger miss was Cardinals' scoring (-8.7 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 41 against 45.4 projected (-4.4), about the 37th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±13.2).

Margin: Chiefs by 27 against Chiefs by 14 projected, about the 85th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12.8).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Chiefs ×1.02, Cardinals ×1.00. It favored Chiefs, who did beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
KC ML (-1460) at -1460: the algo gave it 90% vs 90% fair (-0.4 pts) — won (+0.1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 90%). ARI ML (+850) at +850: the algo gave it 10% vs 10% fair (+0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 10%). KC -15.5 (-109) at -109: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the closing -14.5 by 1. ARI +15.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing +14.5 by 1. OVER 40.5 (-107) at -107: the algo gave it 51% vs 49% fair (+1.6 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 40.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 49% vs 51% fair (-1.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Chiefs -15.5 → -14.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 51% of bets on Cardinals, 48% of the money — Chiefs covered; total: 69% of bets on the over, 69% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 2% of bets on Cardinals, 31% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Chiefs, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.887 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +11.7 points. It counts toward NFL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 44 graded NFL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.981 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Cardinals attack ×0.960, defense ×1.021 (4 games); Chiefs attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 13 points), no bet.
